answer: Put capability token with time window restriction at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. A farm running 579 aliases would need 579 separate proofs, each costing about 119 POA or 13 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. One marble of signal, one zenith of cost, one spiral of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
